thesis: Mohnish Pabrai argues that humans generally have an aversion to cloning successful ideas, even when they are directly exposed to them, which creates a competitive advantage for those who force themselves to copy smart strategies. He illustrates this by explaining how he proved Tom Peters wrong by becoming a 'master cloner' of simple ideas, citing examples like Microsoft copying features from competitors and Jim Sinegal cloning the Costco model from Sun Price.
